scripts.build: npm run build --prefix indexer && npm run build --prefix streamer && npm run build --prefix downloader
scripts.start: npm run build && systemctl --user start gallery-indexer gallery-streamer gallery-downloader gallery-ocr
scripts.restart: npm run build && systemctl --user restart gallery-indexer gallery-streamer gallery-downloader gallery-ocr
scripts.stop: systemctl --user stop gallery-indexer gallery-streamer gallery-downloader gallery-ocr
